Final categorization: EXCLUDED  
(Justification: The study focuses on land-use change projections along the Silk Road—a transboundary region spanning multiple continents and over 60 countries—rather than implementing analysis at an explicit national scale for any single country. Although sub-regions include individual countries like China (CHN), the modeling framework treats the entire Silk Road corridor as a composite study area divided into nine socio-ecological zones, not as discrete national-scale simulations. This constitutes a regional/transboundary scale focus, which violates the core inclusion criterion requiring "explicit national-scale spatial implementation (entire country)." Additionally, while LULC prediction is a central component, the primary objective is to assess carbon pool impacts under SDG scenarios, making LULC a means to an end rather than the main research focus. The paper also fails the inclusion criterion of national-scale implementation and meets the exclusion criterion of “regional/global/transboundary scale focus.”)
